meaning: stunned and unable to think clearly after a shock or a blow
sentence: He sat dazed on the kerb for a full minute after the fall.

meaning: to weaken someone or something, draining its strength
sentence: A week of fever can debilitate even a fit young man.

meaning: confident, stylish and charming in manner
sentence: He arrived debonair in a linen suit, entirely at ease among strangers.

meaning: to crackle and break apart when strongly heated
sentence: Rock salt will decrepitate noisily if you drop it into a hot pan.

meaning: subtracted an amount from a total
sentence: The canteen deducted the cost of the broken plate from his allowance.

meaning: to remove the fuse from a bomb, or to make a tense situation harmless
sentence: Engineers took two hours to defuse the shell buried beside the runway.

meaning: to treat or worship someone as a god
sentence: Some societies deify their founders within a generation of their death.

meaning: the deliberate pulling down or destruction of a building or structure
sentence: The demolition of the old barracks took less than a morning.

meaning: to fall in value over time; also, to belittle or speak slightingly of something
sentence: A new car begins to depreciate the moment it leaves the showroom.

meaning: to plunder a place and lay it waste
sentence: Raiders came down from the hills each winter to depredate the border villages.

meaning: lays down with authority what must be done; also, says words aloud for another to write down
sentence: Custom dictates that the youngest cadet serves the tea.

meaning: causing great damage or ruin
sentence: The decision to march without water proved disastrous.

meaning: separate and individually distinct
sentence: The syllabus is divided into six discrete units, each examined separately.

meaning: able to judge fine distinctions, and so selective in taste
sentence: A discriminating reader will notice at once that the two accounts differ.

meaning: impartial because one has no personal stake in the outcome
sentence: The dispute was settled by a disinterested officer from another unit.

meaning: showed a claim to be false
sentence: A single careful experiment disproved the theory.

meaning: to branch off in different directions from a common point; also, to differ
sentence: The two paths diverge just beyond the bridge.

meaning: oppressed and badly treated by those in power
sentence: The reformer spent his life defending the downtrodden.

meaning: relating to the economy, trade and money; also, profitable enough to be worth doing
sentence: The long war left the country in economic ruin.

meaning: a result produced by a cause; as a verb, to bring something about
sentence: The new drill had an immediate effect on the cadets' turnout.

meaning: the act of going out, or the way out of a place
sentence: The hall has only one egress, which is a serious fire risk.

meaning: moving outward, especially of air pushed out of the lungs in speech
sentence: Most sounds in English are made with an egressive flow of air from the lungs.

meaning: graceful and stylish beauty, or neat simplicity of design
sentence: She solved the problem with an elegance that impressed the examiner.

meaning: belonging to the raw, primal forces of nature; also, of a chemical element in its uncombined form
sentence: Standing on the deck in that storm, he felt an elemental fear.

meaning: made longer, stretched out in length
sentence: The evening sun threw elongated shadows across the parade ground.

meaning: the act of setting people free from slavery or legal restraint
sentence: The emancipation of bonded labourers was the movement's first real victory.

meaning: to leave one's own country in order to settle in another
sentence: Her brother decided to emigrate to Canada after the harvest failed.

meaning: a position of fame and superiority in a field; also, a rising piece of ground
sentence: He rose to eminence as a surgeon before he was forty.

meaning: the extreme seriousness or wickedness of an act
sentence: The enormity of the crime shocked even the investigating officers.

meaning: to settle oneself comfortably and securely in a place
sentence: By eight o'clock he would ensconce himself in the corner armchair with a book.

meaning: to make certain that something happens
sentence: Check the parade state twice to ensure that no one is missing.

meaning: the clear and distinct pronunciation of words
sentence: His enunciation was so clear that every word carried to the back row.

meaning: to wrap up or surround something completely
sentence: A thick mist began to envelop the valley.

meaning: a flat paper cover in which a letter is posted; also, the outer limit within which something can work
sentence: He sealed the letter in a brown envelope and posted it that evening.

meaning: to speak ambiguously in order to avoid committing oneself
sentence: Asked who had given the order, the witness began to equivocate.

meaning: irregular and unpredictable in movement or behaviour
sentence: His erratic driving made the whole platoon uneasy.

meaning: delicately light and airy, as though not of this solid world
sentence: The dancer moved with an ethereal lightness.

meaning: not including, other than; as a verb, to leave something out of a group
sentence: Everyone except the duty officer had gone to bed.

meaning: intended for the general public rather than for a select few
sentence: The lecture was exoteric enough for a school audience to follow.

meaning: to speak or write at great length on a subject
sentence: Given half a chance he will expatiate on the merits of his old regiment.

meaning: to make amends for a wrong, atoning for guilt
sentence: He worked in the hospital for a year to expiate his part in the accident.

meaning: to explain something in careful detail, unfolding its meaning
sentence: The tutor took a whole hour to explicate a single paragraph.

meaning: to reason earnestly with someone in protest or disapproval
sentence: The captain began to expostulate with the crowd, urging them to disperse.

meaning: spoken or done without preparation, on the spur of the moment
sentence: His extemporaneous speech was better than the one he had prepared.

meaning: no longer in existence, having died out entirely
sentence: The dodo has been extinct for some three hundred years.

meaning: lively high spirits and abundant energy
sentence: The team's exuberance after the win was hard to contain.
